description: NodeRuntimeHandlerFeatures is a set of features implemented by the runtime handler.

cgroupNamespaces.description: cgroupNamespaces is set to true if the runtime handler supports specifying whether to use the host cgroup namespace for privileged and non-privileged containers.

recursiveReadOnlyMounts.description: recursiveReadOnlyMounts is set to true if the runtime handler supports RecursiveReadOnlyMounts.

userNamespaces.description: userNamespaces is set to true if the runtime handler supports UserNamespaces, including for volumes.
